name: legion
summary: Automatic Enumeration Tool based in Open Source tools.
highlights: --mcp-server — Start MCP server for AI integration
--web — Run Legion with the local Flask web interface
--tool-audit — Print a tool availability audit and exit
--tool-install-plan — Print the generated install script for missing tools on the selected platform and exit
--tool-install — Run the generated install plan for missing tools on the selected platform and exit
--web-bind-all — When used with --web, bind the web interface to 0.0.0.0 instead of 127.0.0.1
